finalText:
Migration done. 36 call sites, 12 files:

```
packages/accounts/src/admin/apiKeyAdmin.js      packages/catalog/src/admin/variantAdmin.js
packages/accounts/src/repo/session.js           packages/catalog/src/repo/supplier.js
packages/accounts/src/service/teamService.js    packages/orders/src/repo/shipment.js
packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js           packages/orders/src/service/returnService.js
packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js             packages/support/src/admin/macroAdmin.js
packages/billing/src/service/couponService.js   packages/support/src/repo/sla.js
```

All `db.query(sql, params)` now `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Every file passes `node --check`. Shape matches already-migrated files (e.g. `macro.js`).

Two things left alone on purpose:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`** — 2 remaining `db.query` calls. File header: "Vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4. Do not edit — it is replaced wholesale on every upgrade, and local changes are silently lost." Fix belongs upstream or in a wrapper. Only real blocker left before `db.query` can be deleted from `lib/db.js`.
- **`cache.query(...)`** — ~25 sites. Different object (`lib/cache.js`), not part of this migration.
